paragraphs: Chapter 914
Episode 228. The Siege of Grosh Castle (10)
An hour later, Ballas and Alpen arrived at the Empire, and Dante at the front lines.
"It feels like it's been quite a while since we actually met, Jin, even though we've been communicating frequently."
"It does. Do you feel better?"
"You noticed right away. I've been refining the energy left by my grandfather. But I wish there was also Veradin on the other side, it's a bit disappointing."
"You mean if he was in his right mind."
"I always feel sorry for Veradin since it seems like we're the only ones doing well."
"What's there to feel sorry about? If we can get him back to normal before he crosses the line, that's all that matters."
"I suppose you're right."
"Are you ready for the fight?"
Jin asked this customary question, and Dante's eyes immediately sharpened.

"Of course... The Demon Realm, those damned tribes have troubled the Empire so much through the transition cracks. I've been so angry that I've woken up from sleep more than once or twice. Finally, the opportunity to smash their home with my own hands has come."
Dante clenched the hilt of Rashid on his waist.
"When can we start?"
"If you want, right now. It's been a long time since we went together."
"That sounds good. It reminds me of the old times and makes me miss Veradin even more. If you could beat them up decently and come back as before, it would be great."

"I'm exploring various ways, so wait and see. If Valeria improves her record magic, I'll look into the records of Veradin and Elona Zipel when I get a chance. It might trigger some change by reminding them of something they've forgotten."
"Just imagining it sounds good."
The two men exited the bridge and leapt into the sky.
As Jin spread his mana, the void froze, forming a path. As they started running on the shining ice path, Vanessa, who was sweeping the battlefield, looked back.
"The Sovereign and the Sword Emperor have arrived. Pay your respects!"

As Vanessa shouted, all the superhumans and knights who were in the middle of the battle simultaneously turned and saluted. The air platform creation artifact developed by Qwol for air combat was sparkling.
They completely ignored the demons wriggling right in front of them.
The demons couldn't recklessly attack the allied forces showing their backs due to the salute. They were overwhelmed by the murderous aura of the charging Jin and Dante and could only crouch.
"I'll take the center, and the knights will spread out to the left and right following Vanessa and Hed. Charge!"
"Yes!"
Swoosh...!
A deep and majestic echo spread as Sigmund and Rashid left the scabbard. The void vibrated like a wave, and the demons gritted their teeth, feeling the tremor on their skin.
The ice path stopped momentarily, leaving about five hundred steps to the demon's formation. Dante took a step forward and pointed Rashid at the demons.

"I am called the Sword Emperor. I am here to punish those who dared to defile the Empire and humanity. But I have a question. Among the swords of the Demon Realm, is there anyone who can step forward without fearing me?"
Dante's voice echoed and shook the battlefield.
After a long silence, a demon with a giant axe over his shoulder stepped forward.
"I am Lektus Kitarin, the Grand General of the Kitarin Clan. I accept your challenge..."
Zap-!
There was a flash in an instant. Lektus had his head chopped off before he could finish his sentence.
Even if beheaded, a demon king doesn't die. Lektus tried to continue his answer after regenerating his neck, but the flashes of light kept coming.
It took 2 seconds for Lektus to turn into six pieces.

"The question wasn't to hear your answer. I asked to see if there were any overconfident fools who'd step forward, and if there were, to kill them first. So if there are any more, step forward. I'll be glad to end your worthless lives quickly."
No one stepped forward.

The other demons from the Kitarin clan, who came with Lektus to the third line of defense, were holding their breath. They had heard that their Sovereign, Milius, had died, and the situation was not good, but they didn't realize it was this bad.
"It seems there are none. Then, I will proceed."
Heavenly Single Strike - the sword energy extending from Rashid split the battlefield in half and stormed towards the enemies.
Dante stayed in his place for a while, only shooting his sword energy and slaughtering the demons. Every time the dark sword light scorched the battlefield, a group of demons disappeared.
Along with the Heavenly Single Strike, Ron's Swordless Strike was spreading as well.
"It must have been fun to threaten the weak. You should have stayed in the underworld. You will experience destruction from now on."
The demons who luckily extended their lives for a moment by avoiding the light of the Emperor's sword, a moment later, were torn apart by the wind of the Swordless Strike.
"I see the form of Lord Ron in that Dante guy. You must be proud."
Already, the central ranks of the enemy were beginning to crumble. With the superhumans, including Vanessa and Hedo, and the knights already pressing on, the demons had no chance of resisting.
Then, Jindo swung his sword and moved forward.
"Surely, I see none of them using the flesh of Jito or making sacrifices to escape."
Sakiel's gamble seemed more and more like a certainty.
"Probably prepared some sort of grand magic using Jito's flesh and the power of the demon kings... Whatever it is, it won't be able to go as planned."
Swoosh-!
As the demons were dying in droves, even the blood and flesh that spread like fog couldn't touch the two of them. They couldn't even soil their clothes.

If they scattered to the left and right to avoid Jindo and Dante, they would meet the superhumans and knights led by Vanessa and Hedo, and if they were pushed back, they would be swallowed by Murakan's Black Chain.
They even had support fire from the Golden Ship and various fleets, and Amela's war equipment. The hundreds of thousands, nearly millions of troops, were just meaningless numbers in front of them.
A proper counterattack was unthinkable.
From time to time, there were demons who infiltrated through the sea to the rear of the Allied Assault Force. But they did not expect to deliver a significant blow to the alliance.

Even if they succeeded in infiltrating, they would meet the Golden Ship, and Enya's Fire Barrier amplified by mirrors. Even a great demon king, let alone a demon general, could not break through all of that to strike at the alliance's main force.
"All fleets, all troops. Increase forward speed! Maintain pace and distance!"
The numbers of demons stationed on the defensive line were visibly decreasing in real time. The third line of defense was already as good as defeated.
After about 30 minutes.
There was not a single person left on the third line of defense. There were no demons moaning from wounds, nor gasping for breath just to cling to life.

Even corpses were hard to find. Enemies who were disassembled into particles, enemies who left something resembling a main body when they died. All had dissipated into the air or sunk into the sea. Only the huge purple stains made from the demons' blood remained in the sea.
"We keep going. All the way to Grosh Fortress!"
Without rest, the attack on the fourth line of defense began.
And the fourth line was no different from the defense lines that had fallen so futilely before. Against the overwhelming power of the alliance, the demons could only fall weakly.
It took only two hours to wipe out the demons on the fourth line of defense. This time, too, no demons survived.
"It was a strange war. If it were a fight between humans and humans, there would have certainly been surrenderers and deserters, and negotiations through prisoners.
So many lives, most of whom have lived at least a few hundred years, would not have vanished without leaving a trace.
"I wonder if it's because of brainwashing, I don't know how this could happen...... Does that Zito fellow not have any consideration for his subordinates at all?"
"If he had any thoughts, he wouldn't have watched such meaningless and massive deaths, Dante."

"Of course, I do think that those who threatened Inseo and the Empire deserve to die a thousand, ten thousand times. It's fortunate that knights like us, including you and I, can bear all these deaths. If ordinary soldiers had to face them in battle, even if they were fewer in number, if they had to experience this massive death directly. They might have gone mad."
"You're right. It's our job, and something only we can do."

"In the wars between people and people that will occur after the war with the Demon World is over. Let's hope that there won't be so many pointless deaths. Let's hope there are those who cry out for mercy, and those who say they acknowledge defeat and ask for mercy for their subordinates."
"That will be the case."
Now, the Grosh Castle, wrapped in a protective shield in the distance, began to come into view.
In front of it was the last, the 5th defense line. Being the final defense line before reaching the castle, it was visibly much more heavily manned than the previous battlefields.
However, once again, there was no one who would make Jin feel tense. Paelito, of course, and even the demon kings equivalent to him, had not yet appeared on the battlefield.
On the right, Luna and Runtia were about to break through the 4th line of defense.
In contrast, Zieff and Kinsel hadn't even broken through the 3rd defense line yet. The powerful demon kings continued to be positioned only towards them.
"Dante and I will enter the castle first to see what tricks Sakhil is up to. The main force should join us after annihilating the 5th defense line."
{Understood!}
{Loyalty!}
Jin and Dante dropped like comets into the midst of the 5th defense line demons. The two quickly broke through the defense line, only taking care of the enemies blocking their way.
Leaving the annihilation to the main force, they quickly opened the way. After swinging their swords dozens of times and leaping, they were able to reach the protective shield of Grosh Castle.
With a roar...

Finally, Jin and Dante broke through a part of the protective shield and entered the castle. As soon as they stepped in, they felt a magical energy vibrating so strongly that they had to catch their breath.
And it was a magic that Jin had already felt once before.
"Sakhil, you seem to have used all the flesh you distributed to the demon kings. Show yourself, it's time to admit defeat."
